verdict.rationale: Pigment documents an official MCP server that lets agents in Claude, Cursor and Codex build and edit Pigment models (docs-1, probe-4). Sessions are authenticated through enterprise identity with role-scoped access (docs-22). Separately, Pigment documents block-level edit histories and an Audit Trail API (docs-16, docs-13), but nothing ties agent or MCP edits to that same audit trail, and nothing specifically covers forecast or scenario updates. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that agent/MCP-made changes are recorded and attributed in the same edit history as human edits; specific evidence of forecast/scenario creation via the machine interface; a published API spec (OpenAPI probe returned 404); independent or hands-on corroboration.
